**Image prompt - Models Are Not Good at Everything:** Light, warm-gray background, flat editorial illustration in the site's style. A tidy desk with five small labeled trays in a row - Math, Copying, Rules, Citations, Long documents. Beside each tray, the right tool waiting: a calculator, a copy-and-paste clipboard, a rulebook with a bookmark, an open source book with a magnifying glass, a stack of pages split into sections. A friendly, confident speech bubble hovers above the desk with no words in it. No people's faces, no logos, no text other than the five tray labels.

**Image prompt - Avoid the Naughty List:** Light background, flat editorial illustration. On the left, a long crumpled printout titled only with a red X, pinned to a corkboard and being ignored. On the right, a clean action board with a few cards, each with an owner's initials, a due date and a check box, two already checked. A small robot-arm pen writing a fix note on one card, a person's hand approving it. No logos, no real names, no other text.
